facts_found: Gold Account credit-card APY bonuses (automatically applied when the card and savings account are under the same customer profile): Bronze Rewards Card +0.15%, Silver Rewards Card +0.2%, Gold Rewards Card +0.025%, Platinum Rewards Card +0.15%, Diamond Elite Card +0.3%, EcoCard +0.6%, Green Rewards Card +0.35%, Crypto-Cash Back Card +0%. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_014]
Platinum Rewards Card provides a +0.15% APY bonus on a Gold Account. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_014]
Silver Rewards Card provides a +0.2% APY bonus on a Gold Account. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_014]
EcoCard provides a +0.6% APY bonus on a Gold Account. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_014]

Credit-card APY bonuses do NOT stack; when a customer holds multiple Rho-Bank credit cards, the system identifies all active linked cards and applies only the highest credit-card APY bonus, with other card bonuses not added on top. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]

The stacking policy's worked example uses a Gold Rewards Card (+0.025%), Platinum Rewards Card (+0.15%) and EcoCard (+0.6%) and states the customer receives only the EcoCard bonus of +0.6%, not the sum. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]

Credit-card APY bonuses DO stack with other bonus types, including checking-account APY boosts, relationship bonuses for holding multiple products, and account tier bonuses. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]

For a Gold Account, the EcoCard bonus (+0.6%) exceeds both the Platinum Rewards Card bonus (+0.15%) and the Silver Rewards Card bonus (+0.2%), so EcoCard is the highest applicable card bonus for a customer holding all three. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_014]
Gold Account base APY is 5.5% (flat), and the Green Rewards/relationship-style bonuses are additive percentage points rather than multipliers. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_013]

Linked checking boosts for Gold Account include Green Account checking +0.75% APY and Purple Account checking +0.1% APY, and only the highest applicable checking boost is applied. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_046]
The linked-checking boost is additive to the savings account's base APY and any credit-card APY bonuses the customer already has. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_012]
